caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent light green glass jug set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. The jug is cylindrical with a slightly flared, rounded lip at the top and a defined bottom rim. Around the upper body, just below the lip, there is a decorative pattern consisting of rounded arches formed by applied glass strips, with small knobs at the peak of each arch. The jug has one large, curved handle attached to the upper side, which is also made of the same transparent green glass; the end of the handle features a small, organic-shaped glass detail that appears to be compressed or pinched. The jug's surface highlights its shiny, smooth texture and faint reflections, and subtle internal bubbles can be seen, characteristic of hand-blown glass. There are no visible contents inside the jug, and the drawing captures shadow and light to emphasize the translucent nature of the glass.
title: Glass Pitcher
